info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Transactions API
Shopify Retrieves A List Of All Balance Transactions Ordered By Processingtime

params.name: since_id
params.description: Filter response to transactions exclusively after the specified ID.

params.name: last_id
params.description: Filter response to transactions exclusively before the specified ID

params.name: test
params.description: Filter response to transactions placed in test mode.

params.name: payout_id
params.description: Filter response to transactions paid out in the specified payout.

params.name: payout_status
params.description: Filter response to transactions with the specified payout status

info.name: Shopify Retrieves A List Of Tender Transactions

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of results to retrieve.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: since_id
params.description: Retrieve only transactions after the specified ID.

params.name: processed_at_min
params.description: Show tender transactions processed_at or after the specified date.

params.name: processed_at_max
params.description: Show tender transactions processed_at or before the specified date.

params.name: processed_at
params.description: Show tender transactions processed at the specified date.

params.name: order
params.description: Show tender transactions ordered by processed_at in ascending or descending order.
